summary: One VivaCity camera (315) at Alison Rd & Doncaster Ave; zones 446, 447 and 448 report every bicycle twice (all counts even throughout) and are halved, while the crossing zone 445 is not doubled. The camera's zone layout changed at 11:00 on 2024-07-11, overnight into 2024-10-04 (back to the first layout) and at 11:00 on 2024-10-17, so the crossing and 446 zones are set missing for Jul 12-Oct 3 and each zone is split into series by layout. Only zone 447 continued after Nov 2024; after halving it tracks tube 158 nearby closely, and its Jul-Oct 2024 run is joined to it.
